_comment: Leaf-level (post-flatten) dictionary for the DogTag credential schemas in this registry. Maps every keyPath a schema.ts-valid credential's flatten() walk can produce to {tags, requirement, notes}, PLUS (WP4.14S) the keyPath space dogtag.vaccination.v1.schema.json describes - see the note on that below. This is a DIFFERENT altitude from the JSON Schema files beside it: those validate the pre-wrap plain-JSON credential (the shape validateSchema checks, where it exists); this dictionary describes the post-flatten typed-scalar leaves specs/leaf-commitment.md's hashLeaf actually commits to. See specs/schemas/README.md for how the two relate and for versioning rules. WP4.10S NOTE: this dictionary's 'credentialSubject.dogTagId': required entry describes ONLY the flatten()-shaped keyPath space (a WrappedDoc credential's leaves, or - WP4.14S - a RecordArtifact's leaves, which use the identical keyPath grammar without going through wrap.ts/schema.ts at all) - it is NOT a claim about a device-built profile tree's attribute leaves (specs/leaf-commitment.md section 15's RedactedTagArtifact, dogtag.redacted-tag-artifact.v1.schema.json), which never contains a credentialSubject.dogTagId leaf at all (build_profile_tree takes dogTagId as a bare key-derivation input, never an attribute leaf) and has no non-maskable keyPath of its own; this dictionary is not extended for that leaf space because verifyRedactedArtifact never consults it (its disclosed[].keyPath values are checked cryptographically, never against a keyPath allow-list). WP4.14S NOTE: dogtag.vaccination.v1.schema.json's keyPaths (recordType == VACCINATION) are entered here even though that schema has no schema.ts/validateSchema counterpart - flatten() itself is a generic nested-JSON-to-keyPath walker, independent of whether validateSchema ever ran, so a RecordArtifact built by hashing a vaccination-shaped credential's flattened leaves directly (specs/leaf-commitment.md section 16) lands at the SAME keyPaths this dictionary already uses for the rabies-shaped fields it reuses (vaccineProductName and siblings) or newly introduces (targetDisease and siblings). Unlike the schema.ts-validated five, 'required' below for a VACCINATION-only keyPath means 'this exact wave's own verifyRecordArtifact non-maskable-set check requires it disclosed', not 'schema.ts's validateSchema rejects its absence' - noted per entry.
wildcardConvention: A segment written [*] is a DICTIONARY PATTERN standing for any concrete array index (weightHistory[*].value matches weightHistory[0].value, weightHistory[1].value, ...). [*] is NOT valid F2a keyPath syntax and must never be hashed literally - it exists only so this dictionary does not need one entry per array position.

requirementLegend.required: Always present with a non-null value in every schema.ts-valid credential the entry's scope applies to.
requirementLegend.optional: May be entirely absent (flatten() then produces no leaf at this keyPath at all - not a leaf, not a null leaf, nothing). When present, must conform to the listed tags/shape.
requirementLegend.nullable: May be present as an explicit TypeTag.Null leaf, either directly or via flatten's empty-object/empty-array collapse rule (F2a: an empty {} or [] at this path produces exactly one leaf here with tag Null).

@context[*].notes: Every element of the VC @context array. index 0 is pinned to the W3C VC 2.0 base context by the envelope schema; the DogTag context URI must appear at some index.

type[*].notes: Every element of the VC type array. Must contain "VerifiableCredential"; RabiesVaccinationCertificate/DOT are recognized additional values.

issuer.notes: schema.ts's reqPresent enforces only non-null presence, not a string shape - every existing fixture and this dictionary's String tag covers the DID-string case actually in use. A future W3C-VC-legal object-shaped issuer ({id, ...}) would flatten into issuer.id / issuer.* leaves instead of one issuer leaf; not covered here because no fixture in this repository uses that shape yet. WP4.14S materializes exactly this anticipated shape for VACCINATION record artifacts - see issuer.chainId/contract/operator/name/domain/address below; a bare 'issuer' leaf and the issuer.* leaves are mutually exclusive per credential (F2a: a scalar value produces a leaf at its own path, an object recurses into children instead).

issuer.chainId.notes: WP4.14S, VACCINATION record artifacts only. The ROAX chain id this root was (or will be) anchored on. Non-maskable: verifyRecordArtifact's non-maskable-set check requires it disclosed. The on-chain binding rule cross-checks it against the chain the verifier is actually running against (specs/leaf-commitment.md section 16).

issuer.contract.notes: WP4.14S, VACCINATION record artifacts only. The VetIssuer clone address (0x..) this root was issued against. Non-maskable. The on-chain binding rule cross-checks rootIssuer(root) == this value.

issuer.operator.notes: WP4.14S, VACCINATION record artifacts only. The vet's whitelisted wallet address that called issueRecord. Non-maskable. The on-chain binding rule cross-checks issuedBy(root) == this value.

issuer.name.notes: WP4.14S, VACCINATION record artifacts only. Clinic display name. Maskable - not part of the non-maskable set.

issuer.domain.notes: WP4.14S, VACCINATION record artifacts only. Clinic domain. Maskable.

issuer.address.notes: WP4.14S, VACCINATION record artifacts only. Clinic postal address of record. Maskable - distinct from issuer.contract (the on-chain address) and from authorizedVet (the practitioner).

credentialSchema.version.notes: WP4.14S. Absent for the five original VC record types (their credentialSchema is the plain W3C {id, type} shape, no version sub-field). Non-maskable and required-in-practice for a VACCINATION record artifact (specs/leaf-commitment.md section 16, dogtag.vaccination.v1.schema.json) - verifyRecordArtifact's non-maskable-set check requires it disclosed.

recordType.notes: Absent on a bare/minimal credential. One of DOG_PROFILE | VACCINATION | SERVICE_ATTESTATION | EU_HEALTH_CERT | CDC_IMPORT_FORM in the fixtures this registry covers. RabiesVaccinationCertificate gates on the type array instead of this field - see dogtag.rabies-vaccination.v1's description.

credentialSubject.sex.notes: Required for DOG_PROFILE. One of male | female.

credentialSubject.neuterStatus.notes: Required for DOG_PROFILE. One of intact | neutered | spayed.

credentialSubject.dateOfBirth.notes: Required for DOG_PROFILE. Used by RabiesVaccinationCertificate's 12-week minimum-age rule when present, but not required by it.

credentialSubject.ownerIdentity.countryO.notes: Required (key must be present, empty string allowed) whenever credentialSubject.ownerIdentity is present - DOG_PROFILE only.

credentialSubject.weightHistory[*].unit.notes: One of kg | lb. Present only when credentialSubject.weightHistory is a non-empty array (DOG_PROFILE).

credentialSubject.weightHistory[*].value.notes: Canonical Decimal-string weight; no magnitude constraint in schema.ts.

credentialSubject.weightHistory.notes: This exact keyPath is only ever a LEAF (rather than an internal node with weightHistory[*].* children) when the array is present and EMPTY - F2a's empty-array rule. A non-empty array produces weightHistory[*].* leaves instead, never a leaf at this bare path. An absent weightHistory key produces no leaf at all, at either path.

credentialSubject.microchip.code.notes: Required, matching ^[0-9]{15}$, whenever credentialSubject.microchip is present. The whole microchip object is REQUIRED (needsChip) for RabiesVaccinationCertificate and EU_HEALTH_CERT, and for any credential carrying top-level cdcPath == "standard"; optional for DOG_PROFILE, SERVICE_ATTESTATION, and CDC_IMPORT_FORM otherwise. When the key is entirely absent, none of the three microchip.* leaves exist.

credentialSubject.microchip.standard.notes: One of ISO_11784_11785 | OTHER. Same presence condition as microchip.code.

credentialSubject.microchip.implantDate.notes: Same presence condition as microchip.code. Used in the rabies implantDate <= vaccinationDate cross-field rule.

credentialSubject.registrationId.notes: Local government registration or licence id.

credentialSubject.registrationAuthority.notes: Authority that issued registrationId, e.g. AVS Singapore, so the id stays unambiguous across jurisdictions.

vaccineProductCode.notes: Required when type includes RabiesVaccinationCertificate. Also usable (optional, maskable) by a WP4.14S VACCINATION record artifact - dogtag.vaccination.v1.schema.json keeps this keyPath name for interop.

vaccineProductName.notes: Required for RabiesVaccinationCertificate. Also usable (optional, maskable) by a WP4.14S VACCINATION record artifact.

vaccineManufacturer.notes: Required for RabiesVaccinationCertificate. Also usable (optional, maskable) by a WP4.14S VACCINATION record artifact.

batchLotNumber.notes: Required for RabiesVaccinationCertificate. Also usable (optional, maskable) by a WP4.14S VACCINATION record artifact.

vaccinationDate.notes: Required for RabiesVaccinationCertificate. Also usable (optional, maskable) by a WP4.14S VACCINATION record artifact - the clinical date leaf; block number/chain time are uncommitted anchoring metadata, never a leaf (specs/leaf-commitment.md section 16).

validUntil.notes: Required for RabiesVaccinationCertificate. Also usable (optional, maskable) by a WP4.14S VACCINATION record artifact.

nextDueDate.notes: Required for RabiesVaccinationCertificate. Also usable (optional, maskable) by a WP4.14S VACCINATION record artifact.

authorizedVet.notes: Required for RabiesVaccinationCertificate. Also usable (optional, maskable) by a WP4.14S VACCINATION record artifact - the certifying practitioner's name/title, distinct from issuer.operator (wallet) and issuer.contract (clinic contract).

series.notes: Required for RabiesVaccinationCertificate. One of primary | booster. Also usable (optional, maskable) by a WP4.14S VACCINATION record artifact.

targetDisease.notes: WP4.14S, VACCINATION record artifacts only. The disease this vaccination protects against, e.g. "rabies" (FHIR Immunization.protocolApplied.targetDisease - specs/standards/hl7-fhir-immunization/r4.yaml). Maskable. A rabies-specific credential may keep using dogtag.rabies-vaccination.v1's type-array gate instead, which has no targetDisease leaf of its own.

targetDiseaseCode.notes: WP4.14S, VACCINATION record artifacts only. Optional coded form of targetDisease (SNOMED CT Veterinary Extension or VeNom - specs/standards/README.md). Maskable.

route.notes: WP4.14S, VACCINATION record artifacts only. Route of administration, e.g. subcutaneous (FHIR Immunization.route). Maskable.

site.notes: WP4.14S, VACCINATION record artifacts only. Body site the vaccine was administered at (FHIR Immunization.site). Maskable.

doseQuantity.notes: WP4.14S, VACCINATION record artifacts only. Amount of vaccine administered, canonical Decimal-string (never a float - specs/leaf-commitment.md section 1). Maskable.

vaccineExpirationDate.notes: WP4.14S, VACCINATION record artifacts only. The administered dose's own shelf-life expiration date (FHIR Immunization.expirationDate) - distinct from validUntil (the animal's protection window). Maskable.

titer.resultIUml.notes: Required, and must be a canonical Decimal string numerically >= "0.5" (x-validationRules), whenever a titer object is present (root-level titer or credentialSubject.titer - schema.ts accepts either location; this dictionary lists the root-level path used by every fixture in this repository). See credentialSubject.titer.resultIUml below for the alternate location's identical field.

titer.sampledAt.notes: Required whenever a titer object is present; must be >= vaccinationDate + 30 days when it is a string (x-validationRules) - schema.ts silently accepts a non-string, non-null sampledAt with no check at all, a documented code-level quirk this dictionary mirrors rather than tightens. See credentialSubject.titer.sampledAt below for the alternate location's identical field.

titer.labId.notes: Carried by every fixture in this repository; schema.ts itself places no constraint on titer.labId. See credentialSubject.titer.labId below for the alternate location's identical field.

credentialSubject.titer.resultIUml.notes: Same field as titer.resultIUml above, at the alternate credentialSubject-nested location schema.ts also accepts for the titer object (used only when a credential places titer under credentialSubject instead of at the root).

credentialSubject.titer.sampledAt.notes: Same field as titer.sampledAt above, at the alternate credentialSubject-nested location.

credentialSubject.titer.labId.notes: Same field as titer.labId above, at the alternate credentialSubject-nested location.

assistanceType.notes: Required for SERVICE_ATTESTATION. One of service_dog | emotional_support | none.

issuerTrustTier.notes: Required for SERVICE_ATTESTATION. One of adi_accredited | licensed_pro | handler_self_attestation | unverified_registry.

legalContext[*].notes: Each element one of ADA | ACAA | FHA. Present only when legalContext is a non-empty array (SERVICE_ATTESTATION).

storage.notes: Required for SERVICE_ATTESTATION. Always the literal "off_chain" (Art.9 special-category data never committed on-chain).

validUntilEntry.notes: Required for EU_HEALTH_CERT; must equal validFrom + 10 days (x-validationRules).

onwardValid.notes: EU_HEALTH_CERT only. schema.ts applies its <= entry + 4 months check ONLY when this AND validUntilEntry both already happen to be strings - see specs/leaf-commitment.md's schema.ts/leaf-commitment-boundary note; effectively unconstrained in type at the code layer, so this dictionary does not tighten it beyond String.

echinococcusRequired.notes: EU_HEALTH_CERT only. Only a literal boolean true activates the treatmentBeforeEntry range check.

treatmentBeforeEntry.notes: EU_HEALTH_CERT only, required (range [24,120]) when echinococcusRequired == true. schema.ts checks this as a native JS number pre-wrap; per the leaf-commitment spec's float ban, the leaf-commitment layer represents it as an Integer-tagged canonical decimal string (e.g. "48"), never a native number - see specs/leaf-commitment.md section 1 and this WP's LOG item 4.

ageMonthsAtEntry.notes: Required for CDC_IMPORT_FORM (>= 6). Same native-JS-number-to-Integer-string canonicization note as treatmentBeforeEntry.

cdcPath.notes: When exactly "standard", triggers the cross-cutting microchip-required rule regardless of recordType (structurally enforced only in dogtag.cdc-import-form.v1 - see that schema and specs/schemas/README.md).

trustLevel.notes: Stamped by validateSchema itself (mutates the credential in place) to "SELF_ATTESTED" whenever type includes "DOT" - never authored by the credential's caller, so never present before validation and always present with this exact value after it for a DOT-typed credential.
